provenance.title: 315 High Complexity Files
provenance.metric: architectureIssues["N High Complexity Files"] — analyzed files where calcComplexity(content).level === "critical", i.e. 1 + Σ(branch-regex hits) > 30 over the RAW file text, comments and string literals included (index.html:1663-1685, 5453-5454)
provenance.sampleNote: the filed finding names 315 files and cites 5 of them by bare file name (agent-comment.ts, codeflow-fp-filter.test.mts, entrypoint.sh, fp-filter.js, git-issue-create-external-skill.test.mts) — the only two shared with the other drafted issues are the fp-filter pair. Each bare name is resolved here to its single tracked path.
provenance.scoreNote: the mirror scores RAW text, so branch-shaped English in a comment (`and`, `or`, `if `) counts. Deleting the security rationale to lower the number is not a refactor; the `after` scores below are what the delivered files measure.

cited.finding: applies, minor — not a god object, no split
cited.change: one module-scope ROLE_HEADINGS table replaces BARE_TEXT_RULES plus the per-call HEADING_RULES copy; the COMMENT_SOURCES list replaces the hand-unrolled textOnly → textOutput → thinkingOutput chain; one postComment() owns both duplicated post try/catch paths; the unused `pi` and `extractionSource` parameters are gone (caller updated in the same change)
cited.evidence: 15 characterization tests in .pi/extensions/supervisor/test/agent-comment-stage.test.mts, green on the unmodified file before the refactor and green after
cited.deferred: none — the remaining score is prose, not branching

cited.finding: applies, major — one UMD closure mixing six false-positive categories, a hand-rolled SHA-256 and two scanner pairs
cited.change: skipQuoted deleted (`skipString` is the same scanner, now the only copy); the require/import child-process binding scans merged into one pass behind addReceiver(); argvCarriesCodeToken + argvNamesInterpreter collapsed into one argvFacts() pass; parseName() is the one alias parser for import clauses and destructuring (childProcessBindings + safeArgvPolicyNames); QUOTED_LITERAL is the one literal-shape owner for programs and argv elements; hasShellExecution() is a construct table; the three suppression loops share partitionList(); the two aggregate rewriters share mapIssues(); the four stats reconcilers share one keptCounts table; isTestArtifact/isDocArtifact share hasDirSegment(); #2100 then split the 462-line index plus its eight policy modules out of the one closure (the `VBA God Module` work this deferral named), which is what carries the score from 725 to 139
cited.evidence: 201 behavioural tests (test/codeflow-fp-filter.test.mts, -part6, test/codeflow-fp-acceptance.test.mts) plus the shim/bridge contracts pin the public surface — green before and after; the exported API is unchanged
cited.deferred: none: #2100 delivered the sibling-module split under `codeflow/fp-filter/`; the index plus eight modules still score above 30 together, so the file stays a critical-complexity path and the #2033 flag set is unchanged

cited.finding: does not apply — linear bootstrap, 7 small functions; the length is a sequence of steps (temporal coupling), not nested branching
cited.change: none: the score is step count, and any edit here needs a shell harness the repo does not have
cited.evidence: no nested-branch hotspot; the ordering is the contract

cited.finding: does not apply to the metric — `.mts` is not in CODE_EXTS, so the analyzer never scores this suite; its length mirrors the 1750-line module under test

cited.finding: does not apply — test-only and unscorable (`CODE_EXTS` excludes `.mts`)

cmd/cheasee-pi/embedded/docker/codeflow/.reason: the remaining score is six policy categories plus the shared lexical scanners in one UMD closure; splitting them into siblings is the only way under the ceiling #2100 delivered that split (index over eight policy modules under `codeflow/fp-filter/`), but the family still scores above the 30 ceiling in total, so the file remains a critical-complexity path.
cmd/cheasee-pi/embedded/docker/codeflow/.requires: a sibling-module split under codeflow/ that keeps the single-script UMD loading contract — loader changes in run-analysis.mjs (require), ui_rewrites.py (one served route), the Go embed list, the Dockerfile COPY, and the byte-verbatim serve test in codeflow_shim_fp_filter_test.go

.pi/extensions/supervisor/pipeline/stage.reason: the remaining score is branch-shaped English in the explanatory comments (and/or/if/with/when) — the code itself is one linear flow with a single table
.pi/extensions/supervisor/pipeline/stage.requires: no code change is available that lowers it further without deleting the rationale; a new metric that ignores comments is the actual fix

controls.note: The codeFiles control was reconciled from 948 to 951 by #2093, from 951 to 953 by #2136, from 953 to 957 by #2096 (four below-ceiling Dependency/PackageRecord scenario modules), then to 959 by #2097 (the Python parse-spec module and parser regression suite). #2137 adds twenty-one below-ceiling scored files for deprecated-package retirement (eleven production modules plus ten `_test.go` files), reaching 980. #2098 adds eight below-ceiling GitHub adapter, error-panel and tool-call-text modules, reaching 988; its refactor also moves two former critical paths below the ceiling, so criticalCount is 196. #2147 and #2138 are both included in the merged tree: #2147 adds the browser-glue and shim harness files, and #2138 adds the goal-loop and shared git/github modules while moving the worktree-guard deferral to shared/git/worktree-guard.ts. #2076 adds seventeen below-ceiling scored Go modules in cmd/cheasee-pi for the credential-isolation feature (four production modules — `auth_stamp.go`, `auth_drift.go` and the two `auth_stamp_identity_*` stat shims — plus thirteen characterization and contract test files). The combined delivered tree measures 1930 tracked files and 1056 scored files; criticalCount remains 196. #2157 adds four below-ceiling scored modules for the sidecar session-description parity fix (src/sessions_store/describe.rs and its rule suite, src/sessions_store/tests_description.rs for the parser and row cases, src/components/session_list/tests.rs for the panel-title fallback), reaching 1060. #1513 adds the git-best-practice-check skill as thirty-eight tracked files, thirty-one of them scored shell modules — all at or below the ceiling once `lib/gateway.sh` gave up its response half to `lib/gateway-response.sh`, `scripts/remediate.sh` gave up its argv parsing to `lib/remediate-args.sh`, and the 528-line `tests/evaluate.test.sh` became the `tests/cases/evaluate-*.sh` slices — reaching 1094. #2155 (the browser-sidecar discovery fix) adds twenty-seven below-ceiling scored Go modules in cmd/cheasee-pi — instance identity/key, the containers mount probe, the instance registry port with its file adapter, write path and snapshot, plus the discovery scenario, contract and mount-verification test siblings — reaching 1121. No flag moves: the measured critical set still equals the #2033 envelope at 196.
